title: Vouchers
subtitle: Generate ERP GL vouchers. Only ERP IDs are stored locally; item, account, and vendor details are loaded from ERP when needed.
generate_subtitle: Pick ERP item, account, and vendor, then enter balanced debit/credit lines.
edit_subtitle: Update ERP item, account, vendor, and balanced debit/credit lines.
empty: No vouchers match the selected criteria.

status_description.draft: Saved locally. A voucher number has not been assigned yet.
status_description.generated: Local record created with a voucher number. Not posted to ERP yet.

form.order_input_placeholder: Select an Order Data Input set to auto-generate voucher...
form.order_input_description: Choosing an Order Data Input will auto-calculate date, receipt no, description, and balanced debit/credit lines from the backend.
form.finance_info_placeholder: Select account from ERP item finance info...
form.finance_info_description: Debit and credit accounts are determined by the ERP Item's Finance Info tab.
form.reject_remark_placeholder: Optional remark if the voucher is rejected

validation.entry_account_required: Select an account for this line.
validation.entry_amount_required: Enter a debit or credit amount.
validation.both_debit_credit: A line cannot have both debit and credit.
validation.unbalanced: Debit and credit totals must match.
validation.invalid_rate: Exchange rate must be greater than zero.

post.confirm_description: Post {{number}} to ERP GL. This cannot be edited afterward.

duplicate_order_set.title: Voucher already exists for this order set
duplicate_order_set.description: You've already generated a voucher for this Order Data Input. Creating another will add a second voucher for the same set. Are you sure you want to continue?
duplicate_order_set.description_with_numbers: You've already generated a voucher for this Order Data Input ({{numbers}}). Creating another will add a second voucher for the same set. Are you sure you want to continue?

errors.post_failed: Failed to post the voucher to ERP.
errors.cannot_post: Only generated vouchers can be posted to ERP.
